Name: TENTATIVE_PLAYER_PARAM_ST
Description: Misselaneous player params. Mostly DS3 leftovers

Fields.Name: Player Automatic Foot Effect SFX Identifier
Fields.Description: This is the identifier used for the SFXID of the foot effect. It corresponds to ZZZ of XYYZZZ.

Fields.Name: Sniping Mode Player Hide Fade Time
Fields.Description: Fade time to hide the player during precision shooting. The unit is seconds.

Fields.Name: Player Poise Recovery Time Correction
Fields.Description: This is the correction value used to calculate the player's poise recovery time.

Fields.Name: Hollowing Threshold
Fields.Description: If you die while your death level is above this value, you will become a hollow.

Fields.Name: Seed of a Giant Tree Drop Maximum Chance When Invaded
Fields.Description: Upper limit probability of drawing the fruit of the giant tree when invaded

Fields.Name: Dropped Item Pickup Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation ID when picking up a dropped item

Fields.Name: Chest Item Pickup Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation ID when picking up an item from a treasure chest (not used?)

Fields.Name: Insufficient Stats Base Attack Power Reduction
Fields.Description: Insufficient status, Basic attack power reduction amount

Fields.Name: Insufficient Stats Stamina Consumption Multiplier
Fields.Description: Insufficient, status Stamina consumption multiplier

Fields.Name: Insufficient Stats Guard Break Power
Fields.Description: Insufficient status, Repelling attack power

Fields.Name: Shield Scaling Maximum Stat Value
Fields.Description: The maximum status value at which the performance increases, used when calculating the status correction value of the shield's performance.

Fields.Name: Maximum Negative Stamina
Fields.Description: Maximum negative stamina

Fields.Name: Wet Material Override Blend Time
Fields.Description: Material switching interpolation time when overlapped and wet
Client bottle correction magnification during multiplayer

Fields.Name: Seed of a Giant Tree Base Drop Chance
Fields.Description: Basic probability of drawing the fruit of the giant tree when invaded

Fields.Name: Seed of a Giant Tree Bonus Drop Chance
Fields.Description: Giant fruit lottery bonus probability when invaded

Fields.Name: Kick Input Angle
Fields.Description: The angle at which the kick can be taken when viewed from the front of the player

Fields.Name: NPC Player Analog Weight Ratio - Light
Fields.Description: Analog weight ratio for NPC players [%]. Light.

Fields.Description: Analog weight ratio for NPC players [%]. Overweight.

Fields.Name: NPC Player Analog Weight Ratio - Very Light

Fields.Name: Seed of a Giant Tree Invader Special Effect ID
Fields.Description: ID of the special effect applied to the dark spirit of the Giant Nut Seed

Fields.Name: NG+ Scaling Base Special Effect ID
Fields.Description: Standard ID of special effects applied for lap correction

Fields.Name: Arrow/Bolt Model ID Offset
Fields.Description: Offset to add to model ID when displaying arrow and bolt models when equipped in slot 1. (Model Id + Offset value)

Fields.Name: Arrow/Bolt Remaining Model Mask Threshold 1
Fields.Description: 1-step threshold judgment value [%] when displaying an arrow or bolt model and applying a display mask based on the number of arrows. (If it is more than this value, it will be displayed in 1 step)

Fields.Name: Arrow/Bolt Remaining Model Mask Threshold 2
Fields.Description: Two-step threshold judgment value [%] when displaying arrow and bolt models and applying a display mask based on the number of arrows. (If it is more than this value, it will be displayed in two stages)
